name: Action Against Hunger USA
mission: Action Against Hunger’s mission is to save the lives of children and their families. We are there for them before and after disaster strikes. We enable people to provide for themselves, see their children grow up strong, and for whole communities to prosper. We constantly search for more effective solutions, while sharing our knowledge and expertise with the world. We push for long-term change.
theoryOfChange: Hunger is predictable, preventable, and treatable. We tackle the root causes of hunger, helping people earn incomes and improve food security.

dimension_explanations.alignment: This charity is a strong fit for Muslim donors seeking to give sadaqah toward urgent humanitarian causes [12]. It has a long track record of working in high-need areas like Somalia, where it monitors acute malnutrition rates and provides essential water and sanitation services [3][8].
dimension_explanations.impact: The organization is highly efficient, spending $5.46 per beneficiary to provide direct services like health consultations and food aid [7]. In FY2024, it directed 89.7% of its total spending toward programs, which supports its strong evidence-based approach to treating malnutrition [2][8].

Solid financial stability with 10.2 months of working capital available in FY2024

Its work focuses on nutrition, water access, and food security for vulnerable populations [8].
